text:
Raghu Iyer: Magnetron team dropped off 3 rack nodes for alpha preview. We need to confirm NDA scope (telemetry + image transfer) and set a 3-hour priority window for initial bench.
Nina Park: are firmware versions locked? Magnetron mentioned a hotfix but didnt list exact builds.
Raghu Iyer: they listed images: magnetron-os v0.9.8 + accel-fw 2.0. We'll record exact sha and attach. Drive: https://rwd.team/magnetron-alpha (internal).
Samir Rao: bench plan: 1) quick healthcheck 15m, 2) two 40m steady-state runs (1k/2k tokens), 3) 15m cold-start latency sweep. collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and power at 5s.
Maya Chen: Legal: need signed NDA + DPA before we accept raw telemetry. Partner asked for 180-day retention for alpha logs; legal prefers 90d. Magnetron ok with 90d if we aggregate metrics for any external sharing.
Ibrahim Al-Karim: infra note: we'll accept uploads via presigned multipart POST. prefer gzipped tarballs and a manifest.json with session metadata. Sample POST:
```bash
curl -F "file=@session.tgz.gz" "${PRESIGNED_POST_URL}" -F "metadata=@manifest.json"
```
Samir Rao: benchbot, can you reserve a slot and tag MAG-ALPHA? Also create an S3 bucket with 90d lifecycle.
benchbot: Reserved queue 8812, window 2025-08-30 03:00-06:00 UTC. Bucket: s3://rwd-magnetron-alpha-8812 (retention 90d). :white_check_mark:
Nina Park: Magnetron asked whether we can allow read-only access to aggregated charts under NDA for their engineering review. Maya, is that acceptable?
Maya Chen: yes, read-only aggregates are OK with no unit-level identifiers. I'll add the clause. Need signed NDA first.
Raghu Iyer: action items: 1) Maya to get NDA signed (ETA EOD) 2) Ibrahim to provision presigned POST + example script (ETA 24h) 3) Samir to finalize bench configs + seeds (ETA EOD+1) 4) benchbot reserved slot 8812.
Samir Rao: we'll include a small real-model trace (gpt-compat-1B) and a synthetic microburst profile for latency tail testing. seeds and prompts will be checked in.
Ibrahim Al-Karim: I'll add a webhook that verifies checksum and writes a session record to the artifacts DB with tags: partner=magnetron, fw=2.0.
Raghu Iyer: thanks. suggest a quick 20m sync after NDA to align lab ops and eng. propose 2025-08-29 17:30 UTC.
Nina Park: works for me.
Maya Chen: pinged Magnetron legal now. will update here when signed. :thumbsup:
